name: SMARD Electricity Market Data (Bundesnetzagentur)
summary: Static JSON time series of German electricity generation by source, consumption, wholesale prices and cross-border flows from the Bundesnetzagentur market portal.
description: The SMARD portal serves its chart data as static JSON files: an index of weekly/daily chunk timestamps per filter, region and resolution, then one file per chunk. Filters cover generation by source (e.g. lignite), load, forecast and day-ahead wholesale price for Germany/Luxembourg, per TSO control area or neighbouring countries, in hour, quarter-hour, day, week, month and year resolution. Filter and region ids are listed in a community-maintained OpenAPI spec.

endpoints.summary: List the chunk start timestamps (ms) for a filter, region and resolution
Time series chunk starting at a timestamp from the index

coverage.geographic: Germany, Luxembourg, Austria, TSO control areas and neighbouring countries
coverage.temporal: From December 2014 (first weekly index entry) to present

agent_notes: Always fetch the index first and take a timestamp from it; the data file name repeats filter, region and resolution and 404s on a mismatch. Timestamps are milliseconds since the epoch; series values are [timestamp, value] with null for gaps. Filter 4169 is the wholesale price for Germany/Luxembourg and 1223 is lignite generation per the community spec. The docs and spec are in German.
caveats: These are the endpoints behind the SMARD web charts; the OpenAPI spec is maintained by the bund.dev community, not by the Bundesnetzagentur, so the paths can change without notice.
The chunk size depends on resolution (the hour example returned 168 hourly points for one week).
The CC BY 4.0 licence statement was read from the SMARD download-centre page.

verification.notes: Index and chunk both executed without a key; the example chunk timestamp comes from the live index.
